truth_contract.real_cases: unknown: a baseline positive is not ground truth and a baseline miss is not a negative
truth_contract.synthetic_controls: constructed model truth only; not false-alarm or RF-specificity calibration

selection_contract.causal_blocks: eight consecutive source visit indices from one session

coverage_audit.limitation: Every split covers both edges overall, but each rate uses one single-edge session; rate-by-edge is not fully crossed. Each block is only eight consecutive visits (0.96 seconds of valid IQ), so it cannot establish long-track continuity, rare-event rates, or p99 latency.
